keseroglu-2023-wt-her1-her7-venus.note: Source frames 60–144, zero-based, from the 361-time-point recording (0–30.00 h). The first z-plane timestamps place this continuous 85-frame window at 5.002–12.002 h from the start of imaging. Selected a continuous interval during which the caudal bud and the same anterior somite landmark can both be used in brightfield. Before the interval the tail is less distinct from the yolk. As the embryo bends later, axial path length increasingly depends on projection. The source deposit includes the full recording.
